product.name: Boards
product.description: A digital canvas for creating diagrams, wireframes, flowcharts, and mind maps to visualize ideas and workflows.

product.name: Docs
product.description: A collaborative document editor for creating notes, plans, and product requirement documents with embedded visual content.

product.name: Projects
product.description: An integrated project management tool that connects tasks, documents, and communication within a unified workspace.

product.name: Posts
product.description: A team communication tool for sharing project updates, check-ins, and feedback with controlled notifications and Slack integration.
